mse — IMGMETRICS fidelity op

• Data kinds: image2d × image2d → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mse(a, b) (to call the implementation directly, import imgmetrics; imgmetrics.mse(a, b); from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("mse"))

Usage

Mean squared error. A raw quantity that does not depend on data_range.

Formula: mean((a - b)^2) (over all elements, computed in float64).

• a, b: any dimensionality as long as the shapes match (2-D grey, (H, W, 3), 3-D volume). The dtype does not matter either, but the scale of pixel values is carried over as is -- 2 uint8 images and the same 2 as float divided by /255 differ in value by a factor of 255^2. If you want to compare on a common scale, use psnr (normalised by data_range).

• Return value: a Python float. 0 is a perfect match; the upper bound is data_range^2.

• Failure (MetricContractError): shapes differ / empty / contains NaN or Inf (never propagated silently).

If you need the square root, rmse. To measure everything at once, compare_images.
